stories.headline: UK Energy Price Cap Jumps 26% in January, Highest Since 2023
stories.why: Flagged by keyword match on the headline/summary — check the source for full context.
stories.summary: Energy prices for UK households will surge by 26% from January 1 as the Middle East war is pushing wholesale gas prices higher, the UK’s energy regulator Ofgem said in its quarterly energy cap announcement on Wednesday.
